text: Carpentry is the craft of building and constructing structures from wooden materials. At the core of this ancient art is the skillful use of saws to cut timber into appropriate lengths and shapes. The first step in carpentry is the precise and methodical sawing of wood, where straight lines and square cuts are essential for the construction's stability. Once the timber is prepared with sawn edges, sanding follows. Sanding smoothens the surface and removes imperfections, ensuring that the final product meets the desired standards of quality and finish. With each piece of wood meticulously shaped and sanded, carpenters create solid foundations for homes and other constructions, turning raw wood into enduring structures.
